author: Taylor Cox
title: The Week Ahead: Apple's Developer Conference In The Spotlight, ASCO Meeting Could Move Biotechs

organizations.name: asco meeting could move biotechs below

text:
Below is a list of notable corporate events for the week beginning June 4. Note: this list is not comprehensive and all dates are subject to change. All times are ET. Monday
Conferences 2018 American Society of Clinical Oncology (ASCO) meeting June 1-5; Watch for abstracts and data presentations from the event to potentially move biotech/pharma stocks this week. Apple Inc (NASDAQ: AAPL ) Worldwide Developers Conference (WWDC) 2018 June 4-8. LD Micro Invitational June 4-6. Money 20/20 Europe June 4-6.
Notable Earnings Palo Alto Networks, Inc (NYSE: PANW ) Q3 after hours.
Investor Events Companies holding analyst/investor days include: New Relic, Inc (NYSE: NEWR ) and TherapeuticsMD, Inc (NASDAQ: TXMD ). The Supreme Court is expected to decide this week on states’ ability to impose sales tax on online retailers even when those retailers have no physical presence in that state. Watch shares of Amazon.com, Inc (NASDAQ: AMZN ), Wayfair Inc (NYSE: W ) and Overstock.com, Inc (NASDAQ: OSTK ), among others. Tuesday Axon Enterprise, Inc (NASDAQ: AAXN ) Axon Accelerate User Conference June 5-8. Jefferies Global Healthcare Conference June 5-8. Baird 2018 Global Consumer, Technology & Services Conference June 5-7.
Notable Earnings Ambarella, Inc (NASDAQ: AMBA ) Q1 after hours.
Investor Events Tesla, Inc (NASDAQ: TSLA ) holding annual shareholder meeting. Delaware’s sports book will open for betting at all of its licensed casinos at approximately 1:30 p.m., including Dover Downs Gaming & Entertainment, Inc (NYSE: DDE ) Hotel & Casino. IPO quiet period expirations for: Ceridian HCM Holding Inc (NYSE: CDAY ) and nLIGHT, Inc (NASDAQ: LASR ). Offering lockup expirations for: CURO Group Holding Corp (NYSE: CURO ), Odonoate Therapeutics, Inc (NASDAQ: ODT ) and Quanterix Corporation (NASDAQ: QTRX ). Wix.com Ltd (NASDAQ: WIX ) analyst/investor day. Wednesday
Signet Jewelers Limited (NYSE: SIG ) Q1 premarket. Thor Industries, Inc (NYSE: THO ) Q3 after hours. Five Below, Inc (NASDAQ: FIVE ) Q1 after hours. Cloudera, Inc (NYSE: CLDR ) Q1 after hours.
Investor Events Netflix, Inc (NASDAQ: NFLX ) holding annual shareholder meeting. Companies holding analyst/investor days include: Booz Allen Hamilton Corporation (NYSE: BAH ), Molson Coors Brewing Company (NYSE: TAP ) and Skechers U.S.A., Inc (NYSE: SKX ). L Brands, Inc (NYSE: LB ) May sales release premarket. Costco Wholesale Corporation (NASDAQ: COST ) May sales release. IPO quiet period expirations for: DocuSign, Inc (NASDAQ: DOCU ), Goosehead Insurance Inc (NASDAQ: GSHD ) and Smartsheet Inc (NYSE: SMAR ). Offering lockup expirations for: Denali Therapeutics Inc (NASDAQ: DNLI ) and Luther Burbank Corp (NASDAQ: LBC ). Thursday U.S. initial jobless claims 8:30 a.m.
Conferences Piper Jaffray Consumer Marketplace Conference 2018.
Notable Earnings Broadcom Inc (NASDAQ: AVGO ) Q2 after hours. Zumiez Inc (NASDAQ: ZUMZ ) Q1 after hours, will include May sales figures.
IPOs
